entities.name: UE-initiated de-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to de-register from 5G network, either due to switch off or other reasons.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate de-registration procedure.

entities.name: De-registration type
entities.description: IE indicating whether de-registration is due to switch off or not.

entities.name: Access type
entities.description: IE indicating whether de-registration is for 3GPP access, non-3GPP access, or both.

entities.name: 5GS mobile identity
entities.description: IE containing either 5G-GUTI, SUCI, or PEI depending on UE conditions.

entities.name: 5G-GUTI
entities.description: 5G Globally Unique Temporary Identifier used for UE identification.

entities.name: SUCI
entities.description: Subscription Concealed Identifier used when 5G-GUTI is not available.

entities.name: PEI
entities.description: Permanent Equipment Identifier used as fallback when neither 5G-GUTI nor SUCI is available.

entities.name: T3519
entities.description: Timer started when UE sends SUCI in DEREGISTRATION REQUEST to prevent frequent SUCI generation.

entities.name: T3521
entities.description: Timer started after sending DEREGISTRATION REQUEST when de-registration is not due to switch off.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state indicating it is registered with the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: UE state indicating registration procedure has been initiated.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: UE state entered after sending DEREGISTRATION REQUEST when not due to switch off.

entities.name: Switch off condition
entities.description: Condition indicating de-registration is due to UE switch off.

entities.name: No valid 5G-GUTI condition
entities.description: Condition when UE does not have a valid 5G-GUTI.

entities.name: T3519 running condition
entities.description: Condition when timer T3519 is currently running.

relations.description: UE-initiated de-registration procedure begins with sending DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message contains De-registration type IE.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message contains Access type IE.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GS mobile identity IE.
5GS mobile identity IE contains 5G-GUTI when UE has valid 5G-GUTI.
5GS mobile identity IE contains SUCI when UE has no valid 5G-GUTI.
5GS mobile identity IE contains PEI when UE has neither valid 5G-GUTI nor valid SUCI.
When UE has no valid 5G-GUTI and T3519 is not running, UE starts T3519 after sending SUCI.
When T3519 is running, UE uses stored SUCI instead of generating new one.
When de-registration is not due to switch off, UE starts timer T3521.
UE starts timer T3521 after sending DEREGISTRATION REQUEST when not due to switch off.
UE enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state after sending DEREGISTRATION REQUEST when not due to switch off.
UE-initiated de-registration procedure can be performed when UE is in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
UE-initiated de-registration procedure can be performed when UE is in 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state.
